_meta.note: Indicative annual pay ranges (INR, lakhs per annum, total compensation before tax) for the Indian market. These are rough estimates for orientation, not sourced survey data; check current figures on sites such as AmbitionBox, Glassdoor or Levels.fyi.

Data Analyst.overview: Turns raw business data into clear answers using SQL, spreadsheets and dashboards.
Data Analyst.description: Data analysts query databases, clean messy data and build reports that help teams decide what to do next. It is the most common entry point into the data field.
responsibilities: Write SQL queries to pull and clean data
Explain trends and anomalies to non-technical teams
Check data quality and document metric definitions

Business Intelligence Analyst.overview: Designs the dashboards and metrics a company uses to track how the business is doing.
Business Intelligence Analyst.description: BI analysts model data for reporting, build self-serve dashboards and keep metrics consistent across teams. The work sits between analytics and data engineering.
responsibilities: Model data for reporting and dashboards
Work with stakeholders to turn questions into dashboards

Data Engineer.overview: Builds the pipelines and storage that deliver reliable data to analysts and models.
Data Engineer.description: Data engineers move data from many sources into warehouses and lakes, and keep those pipelines fast and trustworthy. Strong programming and database skills matter most.
responsibilities: Monitor pipeline health and fix failures

Data Scientist.overview: Uses statistics and machine learning to predict outcomes and uncover insights.
Data Scientist.description: Data scientists frame business problems as modelling problems, build and evaluate models, and communicate the results. Roles range from analysis-heavy to production ML.

Machine Learning Engineer.overview: Takes machine learning models from notebooks to reliable production systems.
Machine Learning Engineer.description: ML engineers combine software engineering with modelling: they train models, build the serving code and keep them accurate over time.
responsibilities: Train and tune models at scale
Build APIs and batch jobs that serve predictions
Monitor model quality and data drift
Collaborate with data scientists and backend teams

Deep Learning Engineer.overview: Builds and trains neural networks for tasks like vision, speech and language.
Deep Learning Engineer.description: Deep learning engineers design network architectures, manage GPU training runs and optimise models for accuracy and speed.
responsibilities: Design and train neural network architectures
Optimise models for latency and memory

NLP Engineer.overview: Builds systems that understand and generate human language.
NLP Engineer.description: NLP engineers work on search, chatbots, summarisation and classification, increasingly using large language models and fine-tuning.
responsibilities: Build text classification and extraction pipelines

Computer Vision Engineer.overview: Builds systems that interpret images and video.
Computer Vision Engineer.description: Computer vision engineers work on detection, segmentation and recognition for products like inspection, medical imaging and autonomous systems.
responsibilities: Label, clean and augment image data
Deploy models to edge devices or the cloud

MLOps Engineer.overview: Automates how models are deployed, monitored and retrained.
MLOps Engineer.description: MLOps engineers build the platform around machine learning: pipelines, registries, deployment and monitoring so teams can ship models safely.
responsibilities: Build CI/CD and training pipelines for models
Track experiments, versions and data lineage
Set up monitoring and automated retraining

AI Research Engineer.overview: Explores and implements new machine learning methods.
AI Research Engineer.description: Research engineers turn new ideas into working experiments, running ablations and scaling training. Roles often favour strong maths and a research track record.
responsibilities: Implement and test new model ideas
Write up results for teams or publication

Backend Developer.overview: Builds the servers, APIs and databases behind applications.
Backend Developer.description: Backend developers design services that store data and apply business logic, with a focus on reliability, security and performance.
responsibilities: Write tests and handle errors gracefully

Full Stack Developer.overview: Builds both the user interface and the server side of web applications.
Full Stack Developer.description: Full stack developers take features from database to browser, which suits small teams and products that change quickly.
responsibilities: Connect front end and back end end-to-end

Frontend Developer.overview: Builds the parts of websites and apps that people see and use.
Frontend Developer.description: Frontend developers turn designs into fast, accessible interfaces and manage state, routing and data fetching on the client.
responsibilities: Manage application state and API calls

Android Developer.overview: Builds apps for Android phones and tablets.
Android Developer.description: Android developers write native apps in Kotlin, handle offline data and device differences, and publish through the Play Store.
responsibilities: Store data locally with Room or SQLite
Test on many devices and OS versions

Software Engineer.overview: Designs, builds and maintains software across the whole product.
Software Engineer.description: Software engineers solve problems in code, review each other's work and own features through design, delivery and support.
responsibilities: Plan work with product and design teams

DevOps Engineer.overview: Connects development and operations so software ships quickly and safely.
DevOps Engineer.description: DevOps engineers automate builds, deployments and infrastructure, and keep systems observable and reliable.
responsibilities: Set up logging, metrics and alerts
Respond to and learn from incidents

Cloud Engineer.overview: Designs and runs applications on cloud platforms.
Cloud Engineer.description: Cloud engineers provision networks, compute and storage on AWS, Azure or GCP, balancing cost, security and scalability.
responsibilities: Design for scale and fault tolerance

Database Administrator.overview: Keeps databases fast, secure and available.
Database Administrator.description: Database administrators tune queries, plan backups and recovery, manage access and handle upgrades for relational and NoSQL systems.

Product Analyst.overview: Uses data to understand how people use a product and what to build next.
Product Analyst.description: Product analysts measure funnels, retention and experiments, and help product managers decide where to invest.
responsibilities: Segment users and find drop-off points

Engineering Manager.overview: Leads a team of engineers and is accountable for what they deliver.
Engineering Manager.description: Engineering managers hire, coach and unblock engineers while aligning the team's work with company goals. Most come from several years as senior engineers.
responsibilities: Work with product and other managers

Generative AI Engineer.overview: Builds products powered by large language models, from chat assistants to document search.
Generative AI Engineer.description: Generative AI engineers connect LLMs to company data and tools, design prompts, add retrieval, and measure answer quality. The work blends software engineering with applied ML.
responsibilities: Build LLM features with prompts, RAG and tool calling
Evaluate answers for accuracy and safety
Control cost, latency and reliability in production

Agentic AI Developer.overview: Builds AI agents that plan, call tools and complete multi-step tasks.
Agentic AI Developer.description: Agentic AI developers design workflows where models decide which tools to use, handle failures and ask for approval. Reliability, evaluation and guardrails matter as much as the model.
responsibilities: Design agent workflows and tool interfaces
Add memory, retrieval and human approval steps

Analytics Engineer.overview: Turns raw warehouse data into clean, tested models that analysts can trust.
Analytics Engineer.description: Analytics engineers sit between data engineering and analysis: they model data in the warehouse, write tested transformations and document metrics.
responsibilities: Build and test data models with SQL and dbt
Keep warehouse costs and runtimes under control
Work with analysts to unblock dashboards

Cybersecurity Analyst.overview: Monitors systems for threats and responds when something goes wrong.
Cybersecurity Analyst.description: Security analysts watch logs and alerts, investigate suspicious activity, patch weaknesses and help the company meet compliance rules.
responsibilities: Monitor alerts in a SIEM and triage incidents
Run vulnerability scans and track fixes

QA Automation Engineer.overview: Writes automated tests that catch bugs before users do.
QA Automation Engineer.description: QA automation engineers build test suites for web, API and mobile apps and plug them into the delivery pipeline.
responsibilities: Write UI and API test automation
Run tests in CI/CD and report failures
Work with developers on test strategy

Site Reliability Engineer.overview: Keeps large services fast and available using software engineering.
Site Reliability Engineer.description: SREs set reliability targets, build monitoring and automation, and lead incident reviews so outages become less likely over time.

Data Architect.overview: Designs how a company's data is stored, connected and governed.
Data Architect.description: Data architects choose platforms and design models so data stays consistent, secure and affordable as the company grows. The role usually follows several years in data engineering.
responsibilities: Design warehouse, lake and streaming architecture

Technical Product Manager.overview: Decides what to build for a technical product and why.
Technical Product Manager.description: Technical product managers turn customer problems into plans engineers can build, using data and technical understanding to make trade-offs.
responsibilities: Write specs and manage the roadmap
Align engineering, design and business teams

UI/UX Designer.overview: Designs how apps and websites look, feel and flow.
UI/UX Designer.description: UI/UX designers research users, sketch flows, build prototypes and hand clean designs to developers.
responsibilities: Research user needs and test prototypes

Flutter Developer.overview: Builds Android and iOS apps from one Flutter codebase.
Flutter Developer.description: Flutter developers write cross-platform apps in Dart, manage app state and connect to APIs and Firebase.
responsibilities: Build screens and navigation in Flutter
Publish to the Play Store and App Store
